programme.title: À table avec Annabelle
programme.desc: Venez prendre une pause-café et vous asseoir à table avec Annabelle pour un moment ressourçant et authentique avec des femmes de valeur.

programme.title: Bonjour chez vous
programme.desc: On est édifiés, encouragés et informés sur l'actualité musicale, cinématographique et culturelle chrétienne. Dynamisme et bonne humeur sont au rendez-vous.

programme.title: Face-à-face
programme.desc: Relatant certains faits de sa vie au cours des épisodes, Yannis Gautier nous transmet un message d'espoir pour la vie.

programme.title: Paroles de femmes
programme.desc: Un rendez-vous convivial, pratique et actuel qui aide les femmes à vivre leur quotidien en appliquant les principes qu'enseigne la Parole de Dieu.

programme.title: Teach!
programme.desc: Émission d'enseignement biblique conçue pour faire de vous de véritables disciples du Seigneur Jésus-Christ, animée par le pasteur Athoms Mbuma.

programme.title: Ma famille africaine
programme.desc: Trois femmes issues de la diaspora africaine sont confrontées à la trahison, à la honte et au jugement de la société, chacune étant forcée de décider si elle doit honorer la tradition ou suivre la voix de sa propre âme.

programme.title: Deelicious
programme.desc: Votre rendez-vous hebdomadaire pour un mélange unique de saveurs spirituelles et de bonne humeur. Dee vous invite à savourer des recettes inspirantes pour nourrir votre âme. Avec son amour pour le partage, Dena Mwana vous promet des moments riches.

programme.title: Une jeunesse française
programme.desc: Dans le sud de la France, Jawad et Belka, deux jeunes hommes d'origine maghrébine, s'affranchissent à travers leur passion pour les courses camarguaises. Bien plus qu'un combat traditionnel, cet affrontement, sans mise à mort, entre des hommes et un taureau leur permet de prendre leur place dans l'arène comme dans la société française.

programme.title: Le vote latino
programme.desc: Une incursion au cœur des communautés latinos des États-Unis pendant la campagne électorale américaine de 2016 ; un périple à travers huit villes, dans huit états, où le vote hispanique aura un rôle déterminant.

programme.title: A Dios
programme.desc: Une ancienne diva du jazz, oubliée par le temps, passe les dernières années de sa vie dans une résidence pour personnes âgées, avec un préposé comme son seul ami. Malheureusement, elle ne parvient pas à maîtriser ses manières de diva et risque de perdre la seule personne qui lui est chère, le temps lui étant compté pour se racheter.

programme.title: Au féminin, guerre des sexes
programme.desc: Coco, Paloma, Bibi, Nana et Fanta sont cinq femmes qui revendiquent chacune à leur manière les mêmes droits que les hommes. Égalité des sexes, crient-elles. Mais dans une société africaine hautement traditionnelle, il semble que les hommes ne sont pas prêts à les laisser s'exprimer.

programme.title: Au féminin, guerre des sexes
programme.desc: Coco, Paloma, Bibi, Nana et Fanta sont cinq femmes qui revendiquent chacune à leur manière les mêmes droits que les hommes. Égalité des sexes, crient-elles. Mais dans une société africaine hautement traditionnelle, il semble que les hommes ne sont pas prêts à les laisser s'exprimer.

programme.title: Les secrets de l'amour
programme.desc: Désireux de faire fructifier ses affaires, Daniel Manga arrange le mariage de son fils Billy avec Kimberley, la fille d'un riche extracteur de pétrole ; lorsque Billy tombe pour une autre et annule la cérémonie, Kimberley décide de se venger.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Sur une plage grecque, une cinquantaine de réfugiés débarquent d'un canot et fendent la foule médusée. Cet événement va bouleverser les destins d'une galerie de personnages et les confronter à la problématique de l'accueil des migrants en Europe.

programme.title: Rexistence
programme.desc: Plongée sensorielle dans l'histoire étouffée des communautés afrodescendantes au Canada, reXistence ravive des fragments de mémoire collective effacés. Ce portrait historique tissé exclusivement d'archives bouscule par sa poésie visuelle brute.

programme.title: Les rois du court
programme.desc: On jette un regard dynamique sur l'amitié, la famille et le parcours menant à l'âge adulte dans la société actuelle; on brouille les frontières entre documentaire et fiction en plongeant dans les émotions brutes et les combats de deux amis d'enfance.

programme.title: Les derniers pèlerins
programme.desc: Chaque été, des centaines de milliers de pèlerins du monde entier convergent vers les sanctuaires de Notre-Dame-du-Cap et de Ste-Anne-de-Beaupré ; parmi eux, la communauté haïtienne est bien représentée.

programme.title: Timpi Tampa
programme.desc: Lorsque Khalilou, un étudiant brillant et déterminé, apprend que sa mère lutte contre un cancer causé par des années de dépigmentation de la peau, il est bouleversé au plus profond de lui-même. Indigné par les normes de beauté toxiques qui idéalisent la peau claire, il décide de prendre position de manière audacieuse et non conventionnelle. Se déguisant en Leila, il s'inscrit au concours très compétitif de Miss Étudiantes.

programme.title: Ma mémoire
programme.desc: Suite à la cérémonie de réenterrement des ossements de 1 500 Autochtones en septembre 2013, le jeune cinéaste Wendat-Innu Akienda Lainé revisite le territoire de ses ancêtres cherchant sa place quelque part entre l'amour de ses traditions et un grand désir de modernité.

programme.title: MFKZ
programme.desc: Angelino est un jeune perdant parmi tant d'autres à Dark Meat City, une mégalopole sans pitié sous le soleil de Californie. La journée, il livre des pizzas dans tous les recoins de la ville et la nuit, il squatte une chambre d'hôtel minable avec son coloc Vinz et une armada de cafards qui font désormais un peu partie de sa famille.

programme.title: Best of NBA Social - Vol. 1
programme.desc: NBA TV curates and showcases the best social content from across the NBA ecosystem, bringing fans closer to the game, players and culture.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programme.desc: The Turtle brothers take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them. Starring Micah Abbey, Shamon Brown Jr., Nicolas Cantu.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: During World War II, Lt. Gen. Leslie Groves Jr. appoints physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer to work on the top-secret Manhattan Project. Oppenheimer and a team of scientists spend years developing the atomic bomb, forever changing the course of history. Starring Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Robert Downey Jr..

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of paranoia, surviving off-grid with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her while battling the consequences of his past. Starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Chase Infiniti.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders. Starring Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, Jessica McNamee.

programme.title: No Refunds With Darcy and Jer
programme.desc: Married comedians Darcy and Jer bring their take on marriage, parenting, ADHD and mental health to the stage.

programme.title: The Good Father: The Martin MacNeill Story
programme.desc: Weeks after his wife's suspicious death, Dr. Martin MacNeill moves in his mistress under the guise of a live-in nanny. Shocked by her father's actions, his daughter begins to question everything she's known about him while uncovering a web of lies. Starring Tom Everett Scott, Charisma Carpenter, Anwen O'Driscoll.

programme.title: Air Bud: Spikes Back
programme.desc: A dog that plays volleyball helps investigators solve a rash of mysterious crimes. Starring Rob Tinkler, Cynthia Stevenson, Katija Pevec.

programme.title: White Bird: A Wonder Story
programme.desc: A girl in Nazi-occupied France goes into hiding with help from a schoolmate -- a boy who risks everything to give her the chance to survive. Together, they find first love in a stunning, magical world of their own creation. Starring Ariella Glaser, Orlando Schwerdt, Helen Mirren.

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher. Starring Kevin Zegers, Dale Midkiff, Caitlin Wachs.

programme.title: Paddington in Peru
programme.desc: Paddington and the Brown family stumble across a legendary treasure as they embark on a thrilling quest through the rainforests of the Amazon to find his beloved aunt. Starring Ben Whishaw, Hugh Bonneville, Emily Mortimer.

programme.title: Mr. Monk's Last Case: A Monk Movie
programme.desc: Monk steps out of retirement as his stepdaughter's wedding turns tragic when her fiancé dies in a bungee jumping accident. Starring Tony Shalhoub, Melora Hardin, Ted Levine.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, Becky wishes that her family would truly hear her. All of her thoughts and frustrations begin to spill out as she inadvertently starts telling everyone what she really thinks. Starring Alison Fernandez, Judy Reyes, David DeLao.

programme.title: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
programme.desc: Ruby is a sweet and awkward high school student who discovers she is a direct descendant of the warrior Kraken queens. Destined to inherit the throne from her commanding grandmother, Ruby must use her newfound powers to protect those she loves most. Starring Jane Fonda, Lana Condor, Toni Collette.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world. Starring Caleb McLaughlin, Gabrielle Union, Steph Curry.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: Deadpool's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the Time Variance Authority recruits him to help safeguard the multiverse. He soon unites with his would-be pal, Wolverine, to complete the mission and save his world from an existential threat. Starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin.

programme.title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Batman and his new ally Wonder Woman recruit Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash to help them save the planet from a newly awakened enemy. Starring Ben Affleck, Gal Gadot, Henry Cavill.

programme.title: Ella McCay
programme.desc: At 34 years old, Ella McCay becomes the governor of the state she was born and raised in. However, navigating relationships with her husband, father and brother may just be her biggest challenge yet. Starring Emma Mackey, Jamie Lee Curtis, Woody Harrelson.

programme.title: Chris Locke: Captain Bones

programme.title: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: During her morning jog on the beach, journalist Theresa Osborne (Robin Wright Penn) discovers a bottle protruding from the sand. Inside it, she finds a heartbreaking, anonymous love letter. After her paper publishes the letter, Osborne tracks down the letter's reclusive author, world-weary widower Garret Blake (Kevin Costner), in the Carolinas. But, as Osborne finds herself falling hopelessly in love with Blake, she becomes wracked with guilt over the real impetus for her visit.

programme.title: A User's Guide to Cheating Death
programme.desc: Regardless of whether people like to think about it, it is inevitable that everyone eventually dies. While that ultimate fate cannot be avoided, people can do things to help extend their lives and, to use the show's terminology, "cheat death." In this series, health law professor Timothy Caulfield provides viewers with health tips that can help their longevity. He explores methods, products, regimens and treatments that tout their health benefits -- there are a lot of them in the nearly $10 billion anti-aging industry -- and tests them to see which ones actually live up to their lofty claims. Topics include detoxing, personalized medicine and extreme dieting.

programme.title: Sports 30
programme.desc: Les plus récents dénouements dans le monde du sport. On analyse en profondeur les résultats des dernières 24 heures dans toutes les disciplines. Hockey, football, baseball, Formule 1, rien n'échappe à nos animateurs qui discutent également des dossiers chauds tels les rumeurs d'échange, le repêchage des futurs espoirs, les scandales reliés au dopage sans oublier une dose d'humour avec quelques gags bien placés par des collaborateurs de longue date et la fameuse compilation des plus beaux jeux du jour. De l'action en toute saison.

programme.title: Buenas noticias TV
programme.desc: Programa que comparte el mensaje de Jesucristo de una manera actual y relevante. A través del lenguaje audiovisual, se muestran las acciones de personas comunes que llevan la luz del Evangelio, transforman su entorno y crean un mundo mejor.

programme.title: Últimas preguntas
programme.desc: El programa busca dar respuesta a preguntas habituales que solemos hacernos, desde la perspectiva del cristianismo, pero también en diálogo con los fieles de otras religiones.

programme.title: Pueblo de Dios
programme.desc: Serie de reportajes sobre personas que tienen fe y demuestran que, con espiritualidad, un mundo mejor es posible. Asimismo, se comparten experiencias e iniciativas de grupos y personas comprometidas con acciones de solidaridad.

programme.title: ¡Qué animal!
programme.desc: En el primer capítulo, recorremos la Selva de Irati, en Navarra. Es el segundo bosque de hayas y abetos más extenso de Europa, y alberga animales con cualidades tan increíbles como el búho, capaz de girar la cabeza 270 grados sin romperse el cuello.

programme.title: ¡Qué animal!
programme.desc: "¡Qué animal!" recorre esta semana el Parque Nacional de los Picos de Europa, el primero que se creó en España y el que alberga el mayor número de grandes vertebrados.

programme.title: El escarabajo verde
programme.sub-title: Al borde del abismo 2. Ciudades y conservación
programme.desc: Reportaje sobre acciones en las ciudades para preservar a la fauna y flora silvestre europea. Viajamos a Escocia, Irlanda y los Países Bajos para descubrir algunos de estos cambios.

programme.title: Hoteles con alma
programme.sub-title: Hostal de los Reyes Católicos, Santiago de Compostela
programme.desc: Considerado como el hotel más antiguo del mundo. Nació como hospital y dispone de dos restaurantes de alta cocina en los que se sirven platos gallegos.

programme.title: España sin asfalto
programme.desc: Entre Burgos y Soria, Miriam encuentra historia, patrimonio, naturaleza y un lugar lleno de calma. Ambas provincias comparten el Cañón de Río Lobos y unas vistas muy fotogénicas en uno de los parajes más impresionantes de nuestra geografía.

programme.title: Viaje al centro de la tele
programme.sub-title: Los momentazos de Íñigo exprés (segunda parte)
programme.desc: Una mirada al pasado para recuperar alguno de los mejores momentos de la historia de Televisión Española. La nostalgia, el humor y la ironía son los ingredientes principales.

programme.title: Flash moda
programme.desc: Nieves Álvarez presenta este espacio cultural que tiene como objetivo impulsar y dar a conocer el mundo de la moda a nivel nacional e internacional.

programme.title: D corazón
programme.desc: Magazine en directo, en donde hacemos un repaso a toda la actualidad social de nuestro país.

programme.title: Telediario 1
programme.desc: Espacio informativo que presenta las noticias más relevantes en los ámbitos nacional, internacional, social, deportivo y meteorológico. La primera edición repasa la actualidad de la jornada de lunes a viernes aportando análisis y contexto.

programme.title: La suerte en tus manos
programme.desc: Se hace un análisis de los juegos de loterías y apuestas del Estado, y se retransmite el sorteo de Bonoloto y de Euromillones del viernes.

programme.title: Saber y ganar - Fin de semana
programme.desc: Concursos que pone a prueba los conocimientos y agilidad mental de los concursantes a través de un auténtico bombardeo de preguntas de ámbito general. Guest(s): Joan Pera, Angels Moll, Enric Majó, Elisenda Roca.

programme.title: El Grand Prix del verano
programme.sub-title: Final: Polinyà y Quintanar del Rey
programme.desc: Concurso que mide diversas habilidades físicas e intelectuales en el que se enfrentan diferentes pueblos de la geografía española. En cada programa participan dos localidades, divididas en equipo azul y equipo amarillo.

programme.title: La vuelta al mundo en 80 likes
programme.desc: Eva Rojas y Carlo Cuñado recorren Liubliana, capital de Eslovenia, y descubren los rincones más virales de la ciudad.

programme.title: Aquí la Tierra
programme.desc: Una mirada sobre cómo la salud, la arquitectura, la conducta, incluso el arte o la economía, pueden estar condicionados por la meteorología.

programme.title: Telediario 2
programme.desc: Programa informativo cuyo objetivo es resumir las noticias nacionales e internacionales más relevantes de la jornada. Tras un sumario en el que se recopilan los temas que se van a tratar, se suceden las piezas informativas agrupadas por temáticas.

programme.title: Deportes 2
programme.desc: Programa informativo que recoge toda la actualidad deportiva del momento con entrevistas y debates sobre los protagonistas de las próximas jornadas.

programme.title: Imprescindibles
programme.desc: Repaso íntimo por la vida de Enrique Urquijo, miembro fundador y líder de Los Secretos. El documental muestra vídeos inéditos de sus primeros años, rescatados del archivo personal de la familia. También se aborda su legado único.

programme.title: Captcha. No soy un robot
programme.sub-title: Pepe y los robots de cocina
programme.desc: Pepe Rodríguez es el invitado de esta entrega, donde cuatro concursantes pelearán para demostrar que su inteligencia no es artificial. Contarán con la ayuda de Rodrigo Vázquez, quién les acompañará en un apasionante viaje al antiguo Egipto. Guest(s): Pepe Rodríguez.

programme.title: CAPTCHA. El videopodcast
programme.sub-title: Pepe Rodríguez no es un robot
programme.desc: Javi Hoyos explora junto a Pepe Rodríguez cómo sobrevivimos (o no) al mundo digital entre anécdotas, dinámicas y retos.

programme.title: Captcha. No soy un robot
programme.sub-title: Samantha Ballentines, una máquina del drag
programme.desc: Samantha Ballentines es la invitada de esta entrega, donde cuatro concursantes pelearán por el bote. Sacaremos a Platón de la antigua Grecia para convertirlo en un influencer del siglo XXI que despierta conciencias desde su pódcast "La caverna". Guest(s): Samantha Ballentines.

programme.title: CAPTCHA. El videopodcast
programme.sub-title: Samantha Ballentines, una máquina del drag
programme.desc: Javi Hoyos explora junto a Samantha Ballentines cómo sobrevivimos (o no) al mundo digital. En un mundo donde las máquinas aprenden cada día más rápido, demostrar que no somos un robot es casi un acto de resistencia.

programme.title: Plano general
programme.desc: El periodista Jenaro Castro muestra el lado más humano de la cantante Diana Navarro. La gran figura de la llamada copla moderna sostiene que este género siempre ha sido un símbolo de libertad, cultura y expresión popular.

programme.title: Metrópolis
programme.desc: El programa dedica su emisión al cineasta belga Olivier Smolders, quien, a lo largo de más de cuatro décadas, ha construido una de las filmografías más singulares y enigmáticas del cine europeo.

programme.title: Viaje al centro de la tele
programme.desc: Un poderoso viaje por la exitosa carrera de uno de nuestros mejores intérpretes. Sus inicios en los 60, Eurovisión, su romance con Natalia, su éxito en la URSS y en el mundo, su enfermedad y su longevidad artística.

programme.title: Viaje al centro de la tele
programme.desc: Un viaje musical a través de las canciones melódicas que han formado parte de nuestra vida. Con grupos e intérpretes como Alejandro Sanz, Adamo, Alex Ubago, Ana Belén, Albert Hammond, Armando Manzanero, Aute, Sergio Dalma y David Bisbal.

programme.title: Días de cine
programme.desc: Un espacio dedicado a la crítica cinematográfica desde un punto de vista sencillo, ameno y divertido, que invierta, además, al espectador a acercarse a las salas de cine.

programme.title: La belle et la bête

programme.title: Whiskey Tango Foxtrot

programme.desc: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

programme.title: Pee-wee's Big Adventure
programme.desc: Childlike Pee-wee (Paul Reubens) loses his vintage bicycle and embarks on a cross-country adventure to get it back.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: S02 E03 — EulogyDr. Magnus and Druitt struggle to come to terms with the apparent death of their daughter; Will, Henry and Bigfoot must organize and process hundreds of surviving Abnormals.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: S02 E04 — HeroWhen a superhero begins to thwart crime in the city, the Sanctuary team must capture him to discover if he is an Abnormal.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: A Wisconsin widow (Karen Allen) falls in love with an alien (Jeff Bridges) who has remade himself as a double of her husband.

programme.title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
programme.desc: Bruce Wayne's former love is implicated in a mysterious new villain's lethal campaign against crime lords.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: When Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon discovers the resurgence of an ancient brotherhood known as the Illuminati, he flies to Rome to warn the Vatican, the Illuminati's most hated enemy. Joining forces with beautiful Italian scientist Vittoria Vetra, Langdon follows a centuries-old trail of ancient symbols in the hope of preventing the Illuminati's deadly plot against the Roman Catholic Church from coming to fruition.

programme.title: Fightland
programme.desc: Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: At First Light
programme.desc: A high school senior, Alex, has an encounter one night with mysterious lights, and it leaves her with dangerous, supernatural abilities but no recollection of who she is or how she got the powers. She then comes across her friend Sean, who offers to take her into his home until she is better. However, when a mysterious organization with questionable motives tracks her down, the two are forced to run away, embarking on an adventure to unearth the truth of what actually transpired that one night.

programme.title: Giant Little Ones
programme.desc: Franky Winter and Ballas Kohl have been best friends since childhood. They are high school royalty: handsome, stars of the swim team, and popular with girls. They live a perfect teenage life - until the night of Franky's epic 17th birthday party when Franky and Ballas are involved in an unexpected incident that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Rabbits Run
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny and his friend Lola get into mischief as they travel from New York to Paris in pursuit of an invisibility spray.

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless.

programme.title: The LEGO Batman Movie
programme.desc: There are big changes brewing in Gotham, but if Batman (Will Arnett) wants to save the city from the Joker's (Zach Galifianakis) hostile takeover, he may have to drop the lone vigilante thing, try to work with others and maybe, just maybe, learn to lighten up. Maybe his superhero sidekick Robin (Michael Cera) and loyal butler Alfred (Ralph Fiennes) can show him a thing or two.

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: The battle for NINJAGO City calls to action young Master Builder Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, also secret ninja warriors. Led by Master Wu, as wise-cracking as he is wise, they must defeat the evil warlord Garmadon, who also happens to be Lloyd's dad. Pitting father against son, the epic showdown tests these fierce but undisciplined modern-day ninjas as they learn to check their egos and pull together to unleash the inner power of Spinjitzu.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: The citizens of Bricksburg face a dangerous new threat when LEGO DUPLO invaders from outer space start to wreck everything in their path. The battle to defeat the enemy and restore harmony to the LEGO universe takes Emmet, Lucy, Batman and the rest of their friends to faraway, unexplored worlds that test their courage and creativity.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Evolving from single-celled yellow organisms at the dawn of time, Minions live to serve, but find themselves working for a continual series of unsuccessful masters, from T. Rex to Napoleon. Without a master to grovel for, the Minions fall into a deep depression. But one minion, Kevin, has a plan; accompanied by his pals Stuart and Bob, Kevin sets forth to find a new evil boss for his brethren to follow. Their search leads them to Scarlet Overkill, the world's first-ever super-villainess.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Now that Gru has forsaken a life of crime to raise Margo, Agnes and Edith, he's trying to figure out how to provide for his new family. As he struggles with his responsibilities as a father, the Anti-Villain League, an organization dedicated to fighting evil, comes calling. The AVL sends Gru on a mission to capture the perpetrator of a spectacular heist, for who would be better than the world's greatest ex-villain to capture the individual who seeks to usurp his power.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: The mischievous Minions hope that Gru will return to a life of crime after the new boss of the Anti-Villain League fires him. Instead, Gru decides to remain retired and travel to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother for the first time. The reunited siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down the elusive Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who seeks revenge against the world.

programme.title: Fly Away Home
programme.desc: After Amy (Anna Paquin) loses her mother in a car accident, she must uproot her life and move to Canada to live with her father, Thomas, (Jeff Daniels), an oddball inventor with whom she has no relationship. She initially struggles to find her place in her new home, but things change when she stumbles upon a collection of abandoned goose eggs. When the eggs hatch, Amy and her dad work together teaching the motherless birds to fly south for the winter, and their relationship blooms.

programme.title: Amish Affair
programme.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.

programme.title: The Death and Life of John F. Donovan
programme.desc: A young actor reminisces about a dead American TV star and the correspondence they shared.

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: A young boy is sent to live with his grandparents in a remote indigenous community.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Red, Chuck, Bomb and the rest of their feathered friends are surprised when a green pig suggests that they put aside their differences and unite to fight a common threat. Aggressive birds from an island covered in ice are planning to use an elaborate weapon to destroy the fowl and swine way of life. After picking their best and brightest, the birds and pigs come up with a scheme to infiltrate the island, deactivate the device and return to their respective paradises intact.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: An anthropologist (Rick Schroder) leads an expedition to an underground world of prehistoric beasts and primitive man.

programme.title: The Games Maker
programme.desc: Ivan's love of board games transports him into the competitive world of game invention.

programme.title: Meditation Park
programme.desc: A dutiful wife and mother re-examines her veneration of her husband after she finds another woman's underwear in his laundry.

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: Mr. Peabody (Ty Burrell), the most accomplished canine in the world, and his boy, Sherman (Max Charles), use a time machine called the Wabac to embark on outrageous adventures. However, when Sherman takes the Wabac without permission to impress his friend Penny (Ariel Winter), he accidentally rips a hole in the universe and causes havoc with world history. It's up to Mr. Peabody to mount a rescue and prevent the past, present and future from being permanently altered.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Gentle farmer Arthur Hoggett (James Cromwell) wins a piglet named Babe (Christine Cavanaugh) at a county fair. Narrowly escaping his fate as Christmas dinner when Farmer Hoggett decides to show him at the next fair, Babe bonds with motherly border collie Fly (Miriam Margolyes) and discovers that he too can herd sheep. But will the other farm animals, including Fly's jealous husband Rex, accept a pig who doesn't conform to the farm's social hierarchy?

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a night club singer and a 12-year old boy.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: An art collector appeals to Jones to embark on a search for the Holy Grail. He learns that another archaeologist has disappeared while searching for the precious goblet, and the missing man is his own father, Dr. Henry Jones. The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers unite to explore a mythical, uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean. Cut off from everything they know, they venture into the domain of the mighty Kong, igniting the ultimate battle between man and nature. As their mission of discovery soon becomes one of survival, they must fight to escape from a primal world where humanity does not belong.

programme.title: Fightland
programme.desc: Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Room
programme.desc: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: Long married, Fiona (Julie Christie) and Grant (Gordon Pinsent) find their mutual devotion tested by her struggle with Alzheimer's disease. When it becomes apparent that the condition is worsening, she checks into a rest home. Grant visits her a month later and finds that his wife has grown close to Aubrey (Michael Murphy), a fellow resident. Jealous and hurt, Grant finally seeks help from Aubrey's wife (Olympia Dukakis) when Fiona suffers a crisis.

programme.title: Kalinga (Care)
programme.desc: At the age of six, director Kent Donguines' mother leaves him and his family in the Philippines to become a nanny overseas. Now an adult, he shares the stories of several Filipina caregivers in Vancouver, bearing witness to their sacrifice as they struggle to reunite with their children. Kent maps out the emotional landscape and trauma of migrant labor.

programme.title: Watermark
programme.desc: This documentary brings together diverse stories from around the globe and explores our relationship with water and how it shapes humanity.

programme.title: Clara
programme.desc: Isaac Bruno is an astronomer consumed with searching the cosmos for evidence of life. When his obsession jeopardizes his career, he ignores a friend's advice to get his life back on track and instead delves deeper into his research - in part to escape from a tragedy in his past. After Isaac meets an artist named Clara, the two begin an unlikely collaboration sifting through mounds of newly released stellar data in the hopes of making a monumental discovery.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone), a small-time boxer from working-class Philadelphia, is arbitrarily chosen to take on the reigning world heavyweight champion, Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers), when the undefeated fighter's scheduled opponent is injured. While training with feisty former bantamweight contender Mickey Goldmill (Burgess Meredith), Rocky tentatively begins a relationship with Adrian (Talia Shire), the wallflower sister of his meat-packer pal Paulie (Burt Young).

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Although working-class Philadelphia boxer Rocky Balboa lost his high-profile bout with the cocky world champion Apollo Creed, his Cinderella story has caught the national sports media's attention, and he now has the opportunity to capitalize on his sudden fame. Meanwhile, Creed is still smarting from nearly losing to some palooka no one has ever heard of, and arrogantly prods his newfound nemesis into getting back into the ring.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Following his crushing defeat by Clubber Lang, Rocky Balboa joins forces with Apollo Creed in an effort to regain his title.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Heavyweight champion Rocky Balboa trains in Siberia for a match against the Soviet fighter who killed Apollo Creed. In front of a ferocious Russian crowd, he fights for one final showdown.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Recently retired boxer Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) falls on hard times after his accountant mismanages his finances. He stages a comeback of sorts by mentoring fiery young boxer Tommy (Tommy Morrison), while also trying to mend his shaky relationship with his own son, Robert (Sage Stallone). These challenges prove to be at least as tough as any fight Rocky has faced in the ring. He wonders if he will be able to meet them and raise his arms in victory again.

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Now long-retired, Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) runs a Philadelphia eatery and mourns the loss of his beloved wife, Adrian. Yearning to recapture a bit of his glory days, he plans to re-enter the ring for a few low-profile, local matches. All that changes when Rocky accepts a challenge to fight the world's reigning heavyweight champion, Mason "the Line" Dixon (Antonio Tarver).

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B. Jordan) never knew his famous father, boxing champion Apollo Creed, who died before Adonis was born. However, boxing is in his blood, so he seeks out Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) and asks the retired champ to be his trainer. Rocky sees much of Apollo in Adonis, and agrees to mentor him, even as he battles an opponent deadlier than any in the ring. With Rocky's help, Adonis soon gets a title shot, but whether he has the true heart of a fighter remains to be seen.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: In 1985, Russian boxer Ivan Drago killed former U.S. champion Apollo Creed in a tragic match that stunned the world. Against the wishes of trainer Rocky Balboa, Apollo's son Adonis Johnson accepts a challenge from Drago's son -- another dangerous fighter. Under guidance from Rocky, Adonis trains for the showdown of his life -- a date with destiny that soon becomes his obsession. Now, Johnson and Balboa must confront their shared legacy as the past catches up to both men.

programme.title: Drink Slay Love
programme.desc: A 16-year-old vampire discovers she has the ability to withstand sunlight. Sensing an opportunity to round up new victims, her family enrolls her in high school, where her who-cares attitude quickly makes her the coolest girl around.

programme.title: Double Happiness
programme.desc: Jade Li (Sandra Oh) is an independent 22-year-old Chinese-Canadian struggling to live the life she wants while not disappointing her traditional Chinese parents. In an effort to encourage their daughter to start a family, Jade's parents set her up on a series of dates with nice, traditional Chinese boys, but Jade is not interested. When she meets a Caucasian grad student named Mark (Callum Rennie), she has to decide how much her own happiness is worth.

programme.title: Perfect High
programme.desc: A teen's (Bella Thorne) life spirals out of control when she starts abusing painkillers and heroin with her new friends (Israel Broussard, Daniela Bobadilla) from school.

programme.title: Snowtime!
programme.desc: Children (Angela Gallupo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball) in a small village learn valuable life lessons when they form two teams for a massive snowball fight.

programme.title: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
programme.desc: Based on the hit animated television series, this feature film adaptation tells the story of how Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup - three exuberant young girls - obtain their unique powers, become superheroes and join forces to foil evil mutant monkey Mojo Jojo's plan to take over the world.

programme.title: New York Minute
programme.desc: Jane (Ashley Olsen) and Roxy Ryan (Mary-Kate Olsen) are teenage Long Island twins who find themselves on numerous misadventures when they trek into Manhattan on a school day. While the studious Jane intends to give an important speech in hopes of winning a scholarship, the more relaxed and carefree Roxy wants to track down her favorite New York City rock group. Trailing behind them, however, is Max Lomax (Eugene Levy), their school's obsessive truant officer.

programme.title: Pee-wee's Big Adventure
programme.desc: Pee-wee Herman (Paul Reubens), an eccentric child-like man, loves his red bicycle and will not sell it to his envious neighbor, Francis (Mark Holton). While Pee-wee visits his friend Dottie (Elizabeth Daily), the bike is stolen. Thinking his bike is at the Alamo, Pee-wee sets off on a trip, where he meets many remarkable people, including waitress Simone (Diane Salinger) and a motorcycle gang. Eventually, Pee-wee discovers that his bike is being used in a movie and tries to recover it.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus and Druitt struggle to come to terms with the apparent death of their daughter; Will, Henry and Bigfoot must organize and process hundreds of surviving Abnormals.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a superhero begins to thwart crime in the city, the Sanctuary team must capture him to discover if he is an Abnormal.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Answering a NASA message intended for aliens, a space being tries to contact mankind, but an American missile grounds his ship. Scrambling, the so-called Starman (Jeff Bridges) inhabits the body of a late Wisconsinite and kidnaps the dead man's widow, Jenny Hayden (Karen Allen). Determined to reunite with a vessel from his home planet at a predetermined site, Starman and Jenny travel to Arizona. Pursued by military officials trying to kill him, Starman forges a lasting bond with Jenny.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone

programme.title: Charles Bradley à la Cigale
programme.desc: The world-famous vocalist Charles Bradley and his Extraordinaires grace the stage of La Cigale in Paris.

programme.desc: The legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd performs.

programme.title: Dhafer Youssef -- Jazz à Vienne 2018

programme.title: Chucho Valdes at Bata Jazz Malta 2019
programme.desc: Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brings his band Jazz Batá Two to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019; they deliver a performance that reverberates through the historic island.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía and Group
programme.desc: In 1996, flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía made a rare appearance at the Germeringer Jazztage.

programme.title: Mike Stern: Jazz à Vienne

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: Jazz for the Planet

programme.title: Song for My Father

programme.desc: The lives of a mother and son intersect with those of two medical professionals after a tragedy. Starring Monica Bellucci, Pascale Bussières, Aliocha Schneider.

programme.title: Doubles
programme.desc: A young Trinidadian street-vendor travels to Toronto and must decide if he will save his estranged father's life. Starring Sanjiv Boodhu, Errol Sitahal, Rashaana Cumberbatch.

programme.title: Elevator to the Gallows
